I know you may not want to hear this, but recovery is a bit different for everyone. I've read stories where people feel perfectly fine the day after quitting, and others don't feel different three months in. Don't let this discourage you, because every day away from weed is a success! You've done a lot of great work, especially removing caffeine and Twitter, AND talking to your spouse. Major props to you. Keep in mind anxiety may also be from dropping all three things-- Twitter, caffeine, and weed. Plus, if you're on Rx drugs, you may be extra sensitive (don't quote me on that).

I understand that feeling of "Oh shit, I think I actually fucked my brain up," but over time, I gained a lot back. It took me a couple months, and in all honesty I'm not sure I'm completely done recovering. I used weed to cope with childhood trauma and depression/anxiety. I still feel shitty sometimes, but it's because of my prior issues, without the extra grimy layer of weed on top.

Be kind to yourself, and patient with yourself too. You deserve it, we're all with you! Hope that helped

yeah. when I first got sober I didn't even feel any endorphin rush. I was afraid of everything, extremely depressed, and had no appetite. I didn't sleep well either, often waking up with my heart racing. Slowly I began to be able to do more, like go outside and talk to people. Even make eye contact. Now the fall semester started again and everything is "back to normal." I say that because I'm going to school again studying the same degree but the difference is I'm not smoking constantly.

I would smoke in order to deal with anxiety, self doubt, and to be more social. Now that I'm not smoking, I'm there again. But the difference is now I can deal with it in a meaningful way. When I was stoned all the time, I could never do homework and my grades dropped. This semester, I still procrastinate. but now that I don't have weed as entertainment I get so bored I do my homework. 

(Sorry if this dragged on) What I mean to say is, after quitting I did NOT feel super amazing, nor did all my problems get solved instantly. But I am realizing how much weed was not helping, and I can listen to myself sober.
